referenceCandidates.title: Complicated feelings of guilt, loneliness and longing. - Raw Confessions
referenceCandidates.contentPreview: Complicated feelings of guilt, loneliness and longing. | Raw Confessions Raw Confessions Log In Sign Up Complicated feelings of guilt, loneliness and longing. Today was my second-ever therapy session. Once again, I withheld information from my therapist, so all we did was talk about interior design for 45 minutes. After the session, I immediately spiraled and cried, feeling dissatisfied and guilty. I wish my therapist had pried the information out of me, but maybe she has something else in mind. Anyway, during my spiral, I panicked and realized I had no one to talk to about it. The only person I felt would understand and be able to provide useful feedback is basically going no-contact with me right now since he has his own internal struggles. I wouldn’t want to put this all on him anyway.
